notes.title: JeliWave Minor Patch
notes.content:
This update is a small fix and optimisation patch to address a specific issue:

[list]
[*]Changed how the game loads levels to hopefully address a rare issue where the game crashes when pressing "Play" on the Title Screen on a new save file
[*]Fixed some UI/Sound issues on the Title Screen and Pause Menu
[/list]

[b]NOTE:[/b]
If the game crashes after the intro video, try restarting. If it still persists then reinstalling should fix it.

notes.title: JeliWave Minor Update
notes.content:
A small update which adds a couple of features:

[list]
[*] Toggle sprint in options
[*] Button to reset camera vertical rotation
[*] View controls button added to pause screen
[*] Voice volume for Question Blobs adjustable in settings
[/list]
